name: Tazan's Satchel
summary: Near Ratchet, Tazan carries a locked satchel as he deals with pirates along the coast. The Shattered Hand wants the secret information inside.

sections.title: Secrets of the Barrens
sections.body: Tazan deals with pirates camped along the Barrens coast near Ratchet. Therzok, a guild master of the Shattered Hand beneath Orgrimmar in the Cleft of Shadow, takes notice. The guild seeks covert power beyond Warchief Thrall's cautious diplomacy, and marks Tazan for elimination to seize the intelligence in his satchel.

sections.title: A Complex Lock
sections.body: The satchel's lock makes it hard to open in the field. Tazan gave the key to Gamon, his associate, who is a drunken fixture in an Orgrimmar tavern. Rogues seeking the satchel must lift the key from Gamon's pocket without raising an alarm, then they can read Tazan's logbook.

faq.q: Who does this satchel belong to?
faq.answer: The satchel belongs to Tazan, a troll who deals with pirates near Ratchet in the Barrens.

faq.q: Why does the Shattered Hand want Tazan's Satchel?
faq.answer: Therzok and the Shattered Hand want the intelligence from Tazan's dealings with coastal pirates to expand their network and reclaim martial pride from the shadows.

faq.q: Where is the key to open the satchel?
faq.answer: Tazan left the key with his associate Gamon, a drunken patron in an Orgrimmar tavern.
Tazan's logbook rests inside the locked satchel and details his secret trades and ties to coastal buccaneers.

angles.text: As a Horde rogue, you must recover the satchel and lift its key from Gamon to earn your place in the Shattered Hand.
In Orgrimmar, the Shattered Hand seeks covert advantage while Warchief Thrall pursues a more measured course.
